description: This source file defines the CCPaymentServices class, providing various static methods to handle payment transactions (authorization, capture, refund, release, etc.) with the ClearCommerce third-party payment gateway. It includes methods to build XML requests, send HTTP requests, and process XML responses, integrating with the OFBiz framework's utility classes and services.

classes.name: CCPaymentServices
classes.description: Main class providing static methods for processing payments via ClearCommerce, including authorization, capture, refund, etc., by constructing and parsing XML messages and handling HTTP communication.

classes.name: ClearCommerceException
classes.description: Custom exception class for errors related to ClearCommerce interactions.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs an authorization request to the payment gateway, handling response processing and error handling.

methods.name: ccCredit
methods.description: Processes a credit (refund or charge-back) to the payment gateway.

methods.name: ccReleaseNoop
methods.description: A no-operation release method that returns success with existing transaction info.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Performs a refund transaction against a previous authorization.

methods.name: ccReAuth
methods.description: Reauthorizes a transaction with a different amount.

methods.name: ccReport
methods.description: Requests a report from the payment gateway for a specific order ID.
